failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: The coordinator query in hop 3 is formulated as a natural-language yes/no question: 'What is Marcus Grönholm's nationality, and did he win the 2000 World Rally Championship (the 28th season)?' This is a compound multi-part question bundling two separate verification targets (nationality and championship win) rather than a well-formed entity-focused retrieval query.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: The hop 3 query 'What is Marcus Grönholm's nationality, and did he win the 2000 World Rally Championship (the 28th season)?' re-asks questions already answered in hop 2 passages. Hop 2 already retrieved the Marcus Grönholm biography passage stating 'Marcus Ulf Johan Grönholm...is a Finnish former rally and rallycross driver' and confirming he 'won the World Rally Championship in 2000.' Hop 3 retrieves substantially the same documents (the 2000 WRC season passage and Marcus Grönholm biography appear in both hop 2 and hop 3 results).
